title: The steward hook reads plain lifecycle context formats
summary: The context hook now accepts lifecycle context segments, the context they carry, its event and its profile under the plain names `lifecycle-context-segment`, `lifecycle-context`, `lifecycle-event` and `lifecycle-profile` with `formatVersion` 1, as well as under the original `ia.<name>.v1` literals. It still emits the original literals in this release, and its identity still reports `ia.context-hook-identity.v2`, so existing bindings and consumers keep working. A later release switches the hook to the plain names.
